title: Quality Control PLEASE!
text: Quality Control PLEASE!. This is my second box of candles.  The first box blew me away with the quality.  I have gone through half of my 2nd box, but found that about 2 out of 5, the wicks are not centered!  If not centered they will not burn evenly, they will snuff out on their own.  This is very frustrating as I use then in my HobKnob for hot tea pot.  I had a bag of bad candles that just would not stay burned after several minutes. I thought I’d remelt them and re-pour, but that’s not why I bought them!  I want convince and good quality!  So, I will say to the company, “QUALITY CONTROL in need here”!
